mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT a.agent_name AS name FROM aop_asset a WHERE a.agent_name IS NOT NULL AND a.agent_name <> ''
AND a.user_id = #{userId}
AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM aop_agent ag WHERE ag.name = a.agent_name AND LOWER(ag.visibility) = 'public' ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM aop_workflow w WHERE LOWER(w.visibility) = 'public' AND (w.name = a.agent_name OR w.agentk_id = a.agent_name) ) OR a.source_kind = 'api' )
ORDER BY name ASC
